name: Cotton Candy Tarantula | 1g
description:
Sugar-spun sweetness with a floral undertone. The sativa genetics keep things light and social — this is a party strain that happens to taste like the county fair. Burns slow, tastes sweet, doesn't knock you out.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
